people.name: Mr. Brian Savage
people.evidence_quote: We are pleased to inform the appointment of Mr. Brian Savage as a Senior Management Personnel, designated as President, Chief Legal Officer with effect from October 22, 2026.
people.bio_quote: Mr. Brian Savage  brings extensive legal leadership experience in the global pharmaceutical industry with deep expertise in legal and regulatory matters, litigation management and strategic business partnering. Before Lupin, he has worked with Teva Pharmaceuticals, where he held various senior leadership roles, most recently serving as Executive Vice President and Interim Global Chief Legal Officer. Prior to Teva, he practiced law at Dechert LLP.
